method.kind: native fake-input delivery test against a fullscreen Qt Quick window
method.client: fake-input v5 client authorized only through a private XDG desktop entry

interpretation.conclusion: The authorized fake-input protocol delivered absolute pointer enter/motion and a click to a fullscreen Qt Quick surface. The click focused the TextField and subsequent key events produced the expected text. The earlier windowed probe used QWindow::setPosition coordinates without proving the compositor's actual toplevel geometry; those coordinates may have missed its surface. This explains a plausible test-coordinate failure but does not yet prove the exact Kicker popup coordinates or reproduce the reported hover-close behavior.

evidence_files.setup_attempts: run4 missing compiled probe; run5 reused stale service cache; run6 stale executable path. No input was treated as sent in those setup failures.
